about: The fake AI stack's scenario book (O2.1). Each image here chooses its own outcome: the fake hashes the bytes it receives (the detector's multipart upload, the VLM's data URI) and answers with this file's detections and verdict for the scenario whose image matches. Drop an image into a camera folder and the event carries that verdict. reply_delay_seconds delays the verdict reply (the slow-reply failure mode). See backend/ai_contract/fake/AGENTS.md.

verdict.summary: Unknown person at the front door
verdict.reasoning: A person stands at the door outside the expected hours and does not approach the bell.
verdict.description: One adult in dark clothing stands at the front door facing the entrance.

criteria.name: person_present
criteria.evidence: A person is visible at the door in the first frame.

verdict.reasoning: The only moving object is a household cat; nothing suggests a security concern.
verdict.description: A small orange cat walks across the porch boards.

criteria.name: person_present

criteria.name: vehicle_known
criteria.evidence: The vehicle does not match one seen at this camera before.

verdict.summary: A person walks up the path
